# Netsol AI

> Netsol AI is a Prague-based AI agency building custom AI automation, chatbots, AI agents, web applications, and system integrations for businesses across the Czech Republic. Typical engagements start with a free consultation and deploy in 2–4 weeks.

## Company

- Netsol AI s.r.o.
- Address: Školská 660/3, Nové Město, 110 00 Praha 1, Czech Republic
- Email: info@netsolai.cz
- Phone: +420 721 405 452
- Website: https://netsolai.cz

## Services

- [AI Automation](https://netsolai.cz/services/ai-automatizace) — automating recurring business processes (lead handling, reporting, cross-system data sync)
- [AI Chatbot](https://netsolai.cz/services/ai-chatbot) — 24/7 customer-facing chatbots for support and lead qualification
- [AI Agents](https://netsolai.cz/services/ai-agenti) — autonomous multi-step agents that carry out tasks across systems, not just answer questions
- [Web Development](https://netsolai.cz/services/vyvoj-webu) — custom websites, e-commerce, and web applications
- [System Integration](https://netsolai.cz/services/integrace) — connecting CRM, email, calendar, invoicing, and other tools

## Pricing

See [/pricing.md](https://netsolai.cz/pricing.md) — Netsol AI uses custom quotes based on project scope rather than fixed tiers.

## Case studies

- [Creative Hive Co](https://netsolai.cz/pripadove-studie/creative-hive-co) — educational platform for independent makers
- [The Contractors Academy](https://netsolai.cz/pripadove-studie/the-contractors-academy) — e-learning platform for the trades industry
- [Slumber CBN](https://netsolai.cz/pripadove-studie/slumber-cbn) — e-commerce and brand for a sleep wellness company
- [Imagine Health](https://netsolai.cz/pripadove-studie/imagine-health) — website for a medical travel facilitator
